headline: Quarterly results show solid revenue growth across major Indian IT firms, driven by AI initiatives.
summary: TCS posted 15.4% YoY revenue growth and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and LTM also reported double‑digit growth, highlighting strong AI sales. Tech Mahindra delivered the highest YoY growth at 21.2%. Wipro saw modest revenue gain but a slight profit decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue contributed significantly to top‑line expansion and margin improvement.
